Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
ADJUSTABLE CLAMP SUPPORT 



1. Scope — Specifies dimensions and other requirements for adjustable clamp supports to be 
used with following types of clamp and clamp plate; 

Swing clamps according to IS : 5250-1984 'Specification for swing clamps {f/rst revision)' wide 
clamp plates according to IS : 5252-1984 'Specification for wide clamp plates {first revision)', parallel 
sided ciamp plates according to IS : 5998-1984 'Specification for parallel sided clamp plates (///'5f 
revision)' and slotted clamps according to 13:6082-1985 'Specification for slotted clamps (//V^f 
revision)'^ 

1 .1 A typical application of adjustable clamp support to wide c lamp plate is shown in Appendix A. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1 . 

3. Material and Hardness — The material shall be steel suitably hardened and tempered to a 
tensile strength of 600 to 750 N/mm^, spherical seat shall be hardened to a hardness of 45 to 
50 HRC, 

4. Designation — An adjustable clamp support having c/=l\/l12 and A = 80 mm shall be 
designated as: 

Adjustable Clamp Support M 12 X 80 IS : 11325 

5. Finish — Adjustable clamp supports shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other defects. 

6. Preservation and Packing 

6.1 Adjustable clamp supports shall be given a phosphate treatment to class A2 in accordance 
with IS : 3618 - 1966 'Phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against corrosion'. 

6.2 These shall be packed in accordance with best trade practice. 

7. IVIarking — The adjustable clamp supports shall be marked at an appropriate place with designa- 
tion and manufacturer's name or trade -mark. 

7.1 IS! Certification IVIarking— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.
